data.revised_prompt:
Edit the provided scientific journal method figure very minimally, preserving the entire left side, all S_phi rows and thumbnails, labels, equations, and overall style exactly. Only correct the right-side output composition.

Required right-side corrections:
- Keep the chain Q -> soft validity M -> straight-through mask M_ST exactly as is, with the black downward arrows.
- M_ST must feed both observed outputs.
- Add/keep a small gray bypass input label near the observed-depth output reading exactly: “D_raw (fixed depth)”. This gray label should feed directly into the observed-depth output, so the equation reads D_obs = D_raw × M_ST. This D_raw line must not visually originate from the quality Q box.
- Add/keep a separate small gray bypass input label near the observed-quality output reading exactly: “Q (quality)”. This gray label should feed directly into the observed-quality output, so the equation reads Q_obs = Q × M_ST.
- Remove any gray line that visually leaves the quality Q box and goes directly to D_obs.
- The quality Q box should still feed soft validity M via the black downward arrow, and may also feed Q_obs as the quality input. It must not directly create D_obs.

Do not change:
- Left active stereo / geometry / camera-register input stack.
- The five S_phi factor rows and their thumbnails.
- The all-five-rows-to-Q combiner.
- Equations and labels except the tiny right-side bypass labels.
- No red arrows, no gradient/backward path, no loss box, no dense formulas, no decorative additions.

Make the correction subtle and consistent with the existing vector figure style.
